newsitem.title: USA: CHS raises net $394 mln in shr offering.
newsitem.headline: CHS raises net $394 mln in shr offering.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said Friday it raised about $394 million in its public offering of 13 million shares at $31.75 a share.
CHS said it will use $74 million to buy Kanna International SA of Switzerland and the remainder for future acquisitions and working capital.
The distributor of microcomputers and software said it grossed $412.8 million in the offering, excluding additional funds if its underwriters exercise their over-allotment options.
CHS shares hit a 52-week high of 34-3/8 Friday and were traing at 34 in the afternoon, up 1.
